summary: village-content-growth: 8 new BB quests from fresh permies crawl, 3 library resources, master_quests dedupe
details: Village RPG (permies-skip-pep-data @ 280a439). Crawled permies.com (499 pages). Full es/fr/de translations for all 8 (247->246 quests after concurrent maintenance dedupe). Library +3 verified resources: ABANA (metalworking), Scientific Beekeeping (beekeeping), Handweaving.net (textiles). master_quests.json: +28 new BB/badge pages, 54 refreshed, 122 paginated same-wiki-id dupes removed (529->435 unique). Links: 977/1013 OK, all failures in forum-signature noise. Rebased over concurrent village-maintenance push (a59cb35); all validators PASSED. Pushed via VILLAGEKEY PAT after broker auth failure.
